messages.subject: [pomp-announce] pomp version 0.36-5 released
messages.body_plain:
I've just submitted version pomp 0.36-5 to CRAN.  Source code and binaries 
should become available over the next few days.  This is a documentation 
upgrade and bug-fix release.   For specific changes, see below:

    o  The "intro_to_pomp" vignette has been updated.  The first part of the 
vignette centers on a new, more transparent, first example.

    o  A bug in 'pfilter' has been fixed.  This bug was introduced in version 
0.32-6 (SVN revision 315).  Upon filtering failure, state variables were left 
un-updated.  Thanks to Karim Khader for reporting circumstances that led to 
the identification of this bug.

    o  There is now a method for 'loglik' on 'probed.pomp' objects.  This 
returns the synthetic likelihood.

    o  The box-constrained simulated annealing optimization method 'sannbox' 
is now an option in 'probe.match'.

    o  Calling 'states' on a pomp object having no unobserved states now fails 
gracefully (returning NULL rather than generating an error).

    o  The rprocess plugin 'discrete.time.sim' now takes an optional 'delta.t' 
argument to allow for arbitrary (but still necessarily regular) spacing of 
observations.  By default, delta.t=1, in agreement with the previous 
behavior.

Regards,

Aaron

-- 
Aaron A. King, Ph.D.
Ecology & Evolutionary Biology
Mathematics
Center for the Study of Complex Systems
University of Michigan
